instructions: Guess the word in {{tries}} tries. After each guess, the color of the tiles will change to show how close your guess was to the word.
correctSpotInstructions: The letter W is in the word and in the correct spot.
wrongSpotInstructions: The letter L is in the word but in the wrong spot.
notInWordInstructions: The letter U is not in the word in any spot.
chainRuleInstructions: From the 2nd guess, a letter chains from your previous guess. The chained letter is auto-filled and locked.
chainPatternInstructions: The chain alternates: right → left → right → left → right, forming a snake pattern.
chainDeadEndInstructions: If the locked chain letter is wrong for the answer, the game ends early because no remaining guess can become the correct word. For example, if the last letter carried from row 5 is not the answer's last letter, row 6 can never solve the puzzle.
loseReasonUnknownInfoBody: Older versions did not save why a lost game ended. Losses from those records are grouped here as Unknown.
loseReasonGuessLimitInfo: ❌ Guess limit: you used every available guess without finding the answer.
loseReasonDeadEndInfo: 🦎 Dead end: the chain locked you into a letter that could no longer lead to the answer.
loseReasonPacmanInfo: 🐇 Chase: the rabbit reached a cell in a row you had not submitted yet.
todayDashboardInfoResult: Result: where today's game stands. 😎 means you won, 🥲 means you lost, and 😶‍🌫️ means you have not finished yet.
todayDashboardInfoGuesses: Guesses: how many of today's 6 attempts you have submitted.
todayDashboardInfoAchievements: Achievements: how many achievements you unlocked today.
todayDashboardInfoStreak: Streak: your current Daily win streak. After you finish today's game, 🔥 marks that today's streak check is done.
playStatsBreakdownInfoRows: Each numbered row represents one guess row in today's puzzle. Rows that were not reached stay blank.
playStatsBreakdownInfoBefore: Before shows the time from opening today's puzzle to your first input. It is not counted as a guess row.
playStatsBreakdownInfoTotal: Total is the full time spent in that row.
playStatsBreakdownInfoGuess: Guess is Total minus 5m+ pause time.
playStatsBreakdownInfoPause: Pause is the total time from 5m+ input gaps.
playStatsBreakdownInfoEnter: Enter includes incomplete, invalid, and submitted attempts.
playStatsBreakdownInfoSummary: Sum adds the rows together. Avg Guess averages only actual guess rows, so Before is excluded.
playStatsBreakdownInfoHint: ⚠️ appears next to Action when Enter hints were enabled. Because hints can reveal whether a word is valid before pressing Enter, they may affect Action stats.
playStatsBreakdownInfoPrivacy: These stats are stored locally on your device and are only used to show your own records.
detailTrackingInfoIntro: Detail stats are based only on Daily games saved after detailed tracking was introduced. They stay on your device, are not collected externally, and are only used for in-game records.
detailTrackingInfoTrackedGames: Tracked games: Daily games that have detailed play data available.
detailTrackingInfoViewMode: Use the bottom switch to view most values as totals or per-game averages.
detailTrackingInfoTotal: Total: adds up all tracked games.
detailTrackingInfoAverage: Per game: divides totals by the number of tracked games.
detailTrackingInfoRatio: Friction/Submit is already a per-submit value, so this switch does not change it.
detailTimeInfoIntro: Time values help separate active solving from waiting, stepping away, or leaving the puzzle open.
detailTimeInfoUnit: The bottom Seconds / Minutes / Hours / Days control changes only the unit used in this Time section.
detailTimeInfoDuration: Duration: the full elapsed time from starting the game to finishing it.
detailTimeInfoGuess: Guess: active solving time after removing the first-input wait and 5m+ pauses.
detailTimeInfoFirstInput: First input: how long it took to type the first letter after opening the puzzle.
detailTimeInfoPause: Pause: time from input gaps of 5 minutes or longer after play had started.
detailActionInfoIntro: Action values show what happened while you were turning guesses into submissions. They stay on your device and are only used for in-game records.
detailActionInfoEnter: Enter presses are grouped into Submit and Failed.
detailActionInfoEnterSubmit: Submit: Enter presses that submitted a valid word.
detailActionInfoEnterFailed: Failed: Invalid + Incomplete Enter presses that did not submit a guess.
detailActionInfoEnterInvalid: Invalid: Enter presses on a filled row that was not a valid word.
detailActionInfoEnterIncomplete: Incomplete: Enter presses before the row was fully filled.
detailActionInfoDelete: Delete: every Delete or Backspace press, counted as a sign that you revised an input.
detailActionInfoFriction: Friction/Submit is calculated after Enter presses are grouped: Delete and Failed are counted as friction events, then divided by Submit.
detailActionInfoFrictionZeroSubmit: If Submit is 0, the value is shown as - instead of dividing by zero.
detailTilesInfoIntro: Tiles summarize what the board looked like when the game ended.
detailTilesInfoCorrect: Correct: letters placed in the exact answer position.
detailTilesInfoPresent: Present: letters that are in the answer but in a different position.
detailTilesInfoAbsent: Absent: letters that are not in the answer.
detailTilesInfoUnrevealed: Unrevealed: cells you never submitted, so they never received a result.
detailTilesInfoDeadEnd: If the game ends early by dead end, the remaining cells are counted as Unrevealed.
uppercaseDescription: Show board letters and keyboard labels in uppercase.
weekStartDescription: Use Monday as the first day in the calendar.
excludeUrlDescription: Hide the game URL from shared results.
enterValidationHintDescription: Color the Enter key by whether the current word can be submitted.
enterValidationHintCaution: ⚠️ This may affect Action stats by revealing word validity before pressing Enter.
enterValidationHintModeCaution: ⚠️ It may not apply in modes where hints are restricted, such as Event mode.
donateMonsterDrink: Buy the developer a Monster Energy!
lossMessage_phrase: Better luck next time! The word was {{solution}}
aboutAuthorSentence: This is an open source word guessing game adapted to {{language}} by <3>{{author}}</3>.
aboutCodeSentence: Check out <1>the original code</1> by <3>Hannah Park</3> or have a look at <5>Aidan Pine's fork</5> and customize it for another language!
aboutDataSentence: The words for this game were sourced from <1>{{wordListSource}}</1>.
aboutOriginalSentence: You can also play the original  <1>here</1>
patchNote_updateHistory_desc:
Open Information anytime to review update history by version.
The first-visit update popup still appears after each update.
patchNote_shareBadges_desc:
Unlock badges that replace the chain symbol in your shared title.
The default remains Wor🔗dle, while equipped badges can make it Wor🔥dle, Wor🦎dle, and more.
patchNote_newAchievements_desc:
New challenges include Perfect Month, Tail Trap, v1.6.0 play count, Practice wins, Custom wins, and more.
Achievement cards now show which mode they apply to.
patchNote_recipeEmoji_desc:
Two new share emoji sets join the menu: Bibimbap 🥬🍆🍚 and Yogurt 🍏🍇🥛.
Unlock them through special Daily challenges.
patchNote_achievements_desc: Earn achievements by completing challenges! Track progress, unlock cosmetics, and see your accomplishments in the new Achievements tab.
patchNote_cosmetics_desc: Customize your game with unlocked cosmetics — change share emojis, cell fonts, letter colors, chain styles, and win messages. Preview and equip them in Settings. Tap a locked item to see which achievement unlocks it.
patchNote_uiFixes_desc: Settings modal redesigned with live cosmetic preview. Calendar share button layout improved. Alert colors updated.
patchNote_german_desc: Deutsch is now available! Select it from the language picker in Settings.
patchNote_customPuzzle_desc:
Create your own puzzle and share it with friends via URL!
Tap "Create" at the bottom to get started.
patchNote_donations_desc: New payment options have been added to the donation menu.
patchNote_kakaopay_desc: Donate via KakaoPay QR code or transfer link.
patchNote_tosspay_desc: Donate via Toss Pay QR code or transfer link.
patchNote_infoModal_desc:
The info modal now features tabs for each game mode.
Quickly find rules and details for Daily, Practice, Custom, and Create.
patchNote_subtitle_desc: Each game mode now displays a colored subtitle.
patchNote_flags_desc: The language selector now shows country flag emojis.
createPuzzleDescription:
Create a custom puzzle,
Share it with your friends!
dailyModeDesc:
A new puzzle is released every day at midnight (UTC).
All players solve the same word.
Your results are saved to statistics and can be shared.
practiceModeDesc:
Play unlimited games with random words.
Statistics are not saved, and sharing is not available.
Tap "Play Again" to start a new game.
practiceModeWarning: Refreshing the page will discard your current game and start a new word from scratch.
customModeDesc:
You are playing a puzzle created by {{questioner}}.
You can share your results or the game URL with friends.
eventModeDesc:
Event Mode is a seasonal puzzle with special rules and rewards.
It uses a separate answer and record from Daily, so you can play one more round after finishing today's puzzle.
eventSummerGardenInfoIntro: After your first submitted word, the rabbit starts nibbling along the chain path. Letters and colors disappear from cells it has visited, and if it reaches a row you have not submitted yet, the picnic is over.
eventSummerGardenRuleStart: Start: the rabbit begins moving along the chain path after your first submitted word.
eventSummerGardenRuleTiming: Stay time: green cells hold it for 3 seconds, purple cells for 2 seconds, and gray cells for 1.5 seconds.
eventSummerGardenRuleHide: Nibbled cells: letters and colors are hidden after the rabbit passes.
eventSummerGardenRuleGameOver: Game over: if the rabbit reaches a cell in a row you have not submitted yet, you fail immediately.
eventSummerGardenRuleClover: Four-leaf clovers: hit clover cells in rows 2-5 with green results to collect them. Winning early also collects the remaining rows.
eventSummerGardenRuleRabbit: Rabbit badge: wins within 1 minute count toward Rabbit Dash progress.
eventMissionGrassDietHelp: win after using GREEN and GRASS.
createModeDesc:
Enter your name and type the word to guess using the keyboard.
The word must be a {{length}}-letter English word from the word list.
Press ENTER to copy the puzzle URL to your clipboard.
Share the URL with friends so they can solve your puzzle!
patchNote_calendar_desc: Track Daily results on a monthly calendar, navigate between months, and share your monthly record as an emoji grid.
patchNote_localTimezone_desc:
Daily word now resets at your device's local midnight instead of UTC.
No matter where you are, a new puzzle starts at midnight!
patchNote_uiRefactor_desc:
Calendar merged into Stats tab, language selector moved to Settings — cleaner header.
Context icons added to modal titles.
patchNote_sponsors_desc: You can now donate via GitHub Sponsors in the donation menu.
achievement_win_in_1_desc: Win a game on the first guess
achievement_monthly_attendance_desc: Complete every Daily puzzle in a calendar month
achievement_dead_end_tail_desc: Trigger a <deadEndLink>dead end</deadEndLink> from the final chained letter
achievement_bibimbap_balance_desc: Win on the 6th guess with 10 correct, 10 present, and 10 absent tiles
achievement_yogurt_recipe_desc: Use APPLE, GRAPE, and MILKS in one game
achievement_no_present_game_desc: Complete a Daily game with no purple tiles
achievement_no_correct_game_desc: Complete a Daily game with no green tiles
achievement_grass_diet_desc: Win a <eventLink>Summer Garden</eventLink> game after using GREEN and GRASS
achievement_garden_set_desc: Unlock the Clover, Hyacinth, and Rabbit badges
